notes: Foundational taxonomy for the MVP. Terms are controlled: a classification may only reference a term defined here. Synonyms feed the rule-based intent parser; they are matched as whole phrases. Subgenres are genre terms with a 'parent' genre that groups them for display; they are assigned to works in seed/subgenres.json.

dimensions.label: Genre
dimensions.description: Conventional form/genre labels. Necessary for filtering, deliberately not the main discovery signal.

dimensions.label: Theme & subject
dimensions.description: What the work is about: ideas, questions and subject matter it substantively engages with (not merely mentions).

dimensions.label: Mood & experience
dimensions.description: The felt experience of engaging with the work. Multidimensional: a work can be comforting and melancholic at once.

dimensions.label: Pacing
dimensions.description: How quickly the work moves and how much patience it asks of its audience.

dimensions.label: Complexity & demand
dimensions.description: How much attention, interpretation or prior knowledge the work asks for.

dimensions.label: World & setting
dimensions.description: Qualities of the setting and world-building.

dimensions.label: Style & craft
dimensions.description: Visual, sonic, prose or interactive style.

dimensions.label: Content advisory
dimensions.description: Content some people want to avoid; the basis of each work's parents' guide. Strength encodes intensity: 0 = assessed and absent, 0.3 = mild/brief, 0.6 = notable, 0.9 = graphic/central. A missing row means NOT ASSESSED, never 'absent'. Each term belongs to one guide group.
